title: Choosing a Fitness Class
instructions: Listen carefully. Choose the option that best matches what is said or implied.

audio.description: Choosing a Fitness Class. Locally generated synthetic English speech.

transcript.text: I was going to join the advanced fitness class, but the instructor suggested starting with the intermediate group. She explained that the advanced sessions focus on speed, while the intermediate class gives more time to practise technique. I agreed because improving my technique matters more to me right now.

questions.prompt: Why was the intermediate class recommended?
options: It is the only class with places left
It allows more time for technique
It is shorter than every other class

questions.prompt: What is emphasised in advanced sessions?
questions.explanation: The instructor contrasts advanced speed with intermediate technique.
The speaker values technique more than speed at present.
